Star placement is correct: the two handle stars sit at the tops of the concentric rings, the rivet star sits at the crossing, and the two tip stars sit at the bottom ends of the blades. The figure is upright, with handles up and tips down.
The blades run from each handle through the rivet to the opposite tip (66249 to 64407, and 64238 to 65639). This is the correct scissor geometry, but it is drawn as lines and not as shapes.
